title: Michigan's 8th Congressional District Election, 2026
description: Michigan's 8th Congressional District covers Flint, Saginaw, Bay City, and Midland in east-central Michigan. The incumbent, Democrat Kristen McDonald Rivet, is seeking a second term after flipping the seat in 2024 by a wider margin than presidential results in the district would suggest. The district has a Cook Partisan Voting Index of R+1 and gave Donald Trump a two-point win in 2024, making it a top Republican target for 2026. Three Republicans — Amir Hassan, Al Lemmo, and Thomas J. Smith — are competing in the August 4 primary to challenge McDonald Rivet. The race is rated Lean Democratic by the Cook Political Report.

candidates.name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
candidates.summary: Kristen McDonald Rivet is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Michigan's 8th District, first elected in 2024. She previously served in the Michigan Senate for the 35th district, where she was Assistant Majority Floor Leader and helped pass expanded tax credits for working families and safe storage gun legislation. Before elected office, she worked as executive director of Michigan Head Start, served as chief of staff to the state superintendent, and held leadership roles at the Skillman Foundation and Greater Midlands Inc.

candidates.name: Amir Hassan
candidates.summary: Amir Hassan is a U.S. Navy veteran and former federal law enforcement officer running for Congress in Michigan's 8th District. Raised in Flint, he served in the Navy during the Global War on Terrorism, worked as a Watch Commander at Guantanamo Bay, and later as an Intelligence Analyst. He describes himself as an America First Republican and is campaigning on border security, economic opportunity, and opposition to Democratic policies.

candidates.name: Al Lemmo
candidates.summary: Al Lemmo is a retired mechanical engineer who spent over 30 years working at the U.S. Army's Tank-Automotive Research, Development and Engineering Center (TARDEC) in Warren, Michigan. Born in Brooklyn, New York, he holds a bachelor's degree and is a Catholic. He is running in the Republican primary in Michigan's 8th Congressional District.
